resources.string: Learn the basics of what programming is and why it’s essential in today’s world.
Get your computer ready with the right tools and IDE for coding.
Discover how to store and manipulate data using variables.
Learn how to make decisions in code using if statements and loops.
Master the basics of functions to organize your code better.
Learn how to identify and fix errors in your programs efficiently.
Understand the concept of objects and classes in programming.
Learn how to store multiple pieces of data in arrays or lists.
Explore how to repeat actions efficiently using loops like for and while.
Discover how to use pre-built code and APIs to add functionality to your programs.
Learn how to read and write files in your program.
Understand how databases store and retrieve data for your applications.
Apply everything you’ve learned by creating a small project.
Get tips on what to learn next and how to continue your programming journey.
